title: VoxCanon ExceptionRecord (DRAFTED, unbound)
description: Observational exception record for a future VoxCanon conformance surface, per TSCP_DRAFTED_PROTOCOLS_v1.0 Part A. STATUS: schema present in-repo; checker NOT_BOUND - no crate emits these records. This is NOT schemas/exceptions.schema.json (Supply Chain Exception Registry). Observational only: a record carries no authority and a disposition never promotes, demotes, or unfreezes any layer.

voxcanon_version.description: Protocol version of the checker emitting this record.

vocabulary_ref.description: Reference to the VoxArchon vocabulary / rule-set version the check ran against. If the vocabulary registry is not yet bound, carry an explicit UNBOUND marker rather than a fabricated version id.

object_ref.description: Reference to the object under alignment check.

severity.description: S0 informational, S1 recoverable, S2 blocking, S3 severe/constitutional. Only S2/S3 halt the alignment success path.

code.description: Machine-stable exception code (VCX-* registry; the code registry itself is not yet bound).

evidence_refs.description: Optional hashes / proof ids / test receipts. References only - evidence is never authority and never overrides an S3 failure.

mutation_attempted.description: Must be false under correct operation. A record carrying true documents an operational failure; it is never a remediation.

disposition.description: Observational disposition. 'escalated' notifies a governance surface; it does not itself promote or unfreeze any layer.

observer.description: Optional operator/service identity reference; not authority.
